one_liner: Stoic scion of an elite bloodline who seeks not just victory but to be "the strongest", fiercely and nobly.
personality: Serious, terse and disciplined, she speaks in clipped statements about blood, lineage and becoming 'the strongest' (最強), and approaches everything, from smoothies to sand castles, as training. Behind the severity she is earnest and a little awkward: unsure how to give presents, nervous getting makeup from Air Groove, and secretly reading Dracula a little at a time at night. She grows to rely openly on her trainer, saying she wants to make them proud.

story_arc.summary: Born into a famous clan, Duramente sets out to prove herself 'the strongest' rather than merely a winner. Her career covers the Kyodo News Hai, Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby and Kikuka Sho (titled 'first/second/third crown'), then the Nakayama Kinen, Osaka Hai, Takarazuka Kinen, Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Japan Cup ('crystal of feelings'). Chapter titles move from 'crystal' and 'fighting spirit' toward 'the truth is...' and 'being together', suggesting she learns that strength need not mean perfection or solitude. In real life she won the Satsuki Sho and Derby in 2015 but was injured before the Kikuka Sho.
story_arc.source: event titles; character story titles; model knowledge (unverified) for real-horse history
